Technical Lines: Use 1px dashed lines for connecting related elements.
Data Points: Use small filled circles (w-2 h-2) to denote status or list items.

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure Safety Orange text is only used on dark backgrounds. On white backgrounds, use Orange for buttons/borders only, not thin text.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js to use the specific colors and fonts defined above.
3. OVERRIDE SHADCN: Modify ui/button.tsx, ui/card.tsx etc. to match the 'Industrial Precision' style (square corners, bold borders).
4. USE LUCIDE ICONS: Use 'HardHat', 'Hammer', 'Ruler', 'Blueprint', 'Truck', 'Users', 'Building2' icons heavily.
5. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute (e.g., 'job-search-input', 'apply-now-btn').
6. NO ROUNDED CORNERS: Default to 'rounded-sm' or 'rounded-none' for that sharp, industrial look. Avoid 'rounded-xl' or 'rounded-full' except for user avatars.
7. USE SONNER: Implement toast notifications using the Sonner library.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
